profile.headline: Software Engineer at Mastercard
profile.summary: Full stack web developer that has worked for fortune 500 companies in both Waterfall and Agile environments. Highly flexible and adaptable to different tech stacks, programming techniques and customer standards. I enjoy learning new technologies and techniques and put together applications that solve problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Daugherty Product Division - Full stack application web developer for the InReach Network product. 
o	Designing, coding and implementing solutions using the Kanban Agile methodology for projects and managing it through boards in the Team Foundation Server solution. 
o	Coding solutions in java spring boot for our service layer, spring jpa and jooq for our backend layer.
o	Created unit tests on Junit and Mockito.
o	Worked on the front layer of the system using AngularJS, CSS and Bootstrap.
o	Handled the whole deployment process from development to QA and production in Amazon Web Services (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, Aurora, Lambda@Edge).
o	Created a new stage environment in Amazon Web Services to help us do regression testing without disturbing the environment our customer use to demo the features produced during releases. 
o	Monitor system performance through CloudWatch in Amazon Web Services.

Monsanto - Full stack application web developer for the DART system. 
o	Designing and implementing solutions through the Agile methodology for development projects and managing it through Jyra. 
o	Using Test Driven Development to deliver good quality software we we needed to meet 90% testing code coverage by contract. Used Mocha-chai and Enzyme libraries as testing tools.
o Using functional programming paradigm to code with a React/Redux tech stack and CouchDB to store our data that facilitated it. 
o Added front-end features using LESS, CSS and Bootstrap.
o Worked collaboratively in a pod of four developers, performing pair and/or swarm programming to ensure good quality code and met acceptance criteria.

positions.title: Application Owner
positions.description:
Contractor for Anheuser-Busch Inbev - Saint Louis, Missouri

Support of a Warehouse Management solution, a large complex J2EE system critical for the client. Technical architectural and business processes knowledge of the system; code break and bug fixing. Design and development of enhancements.

Technologies: Java 5.1, Java Servlets, Java Tags, Java EJBs, Java MDBs, J2EE Design patterns, Javascript, HTML, CSS, SQL, PL/SQL.
Database:Oracle
Application server: Websphere 6.1/5.1

Support of People systems, Spring-Hibernate based web applications that provides the time management of the companies labor force. Technical ownership and maintenance of the system. Ensuring service availability for users, solving requirements and user requests, designing workarounds and approaches to solve issues and enhance functionalities as well as updating system configuration.

Technologies: Spring, Hibernate, GWT, Birt, SQL, Ajax.
Database: Oracle
Application server: Websphere 6.1

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
General Electric Aircraft Engines - Cincinnati, Ohio 

Contractor supporting and maintaining critical applications mounted in a web portal solution, solving requirements and user requests, designing workarounds and approaches to mitigate issues. Coordinating activities and tasks within the team to complete the development cycle, and backing up the project leader in absences and ownership of other management tasks.

Main responsibilities:

• Gather, Analyze, Design and Estimate customer requirements.
• Develop, testing and implementation, code enhancements, bug/break fixes.
• Jboss application management.
• Oracle design and development with PL/SQL.
• Coordinate efforts with our partners in China.
• Keep track of requirements assigned, and make sure they are delivered with no defects.
• Gather the team’s database changes for code release.

Technologies: Java, Java Servlets, Java Tags, Java J2EE design patterns, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Oracle Database, PL/SQL, UML, XML, SQL.
Tools: Eclipse, Oracle Toad
Application servers: Web Logic, Jboss
